name: Gathered Screen
description: Gather qi from the whole body into one screen at the point of attack and meet the blow with it.

name: Rooted Weight
description: Drop the weight into the heels and let a heavy blow on the ward pass through the legs into the ground.

name: Veered Edge
description: Angle the ward just enough to turn a cutting edge a finger's width past the user's body.

name: Forward Pace
description: Advance a step behind the raised screen so the opponent has no room to swing.

name: Reading Surface
description: Read the opponent's intent from the first ripple of a blow across the ward's face and signal it to nearby allies.

name: Doubled Plate
description: Set a second plate behind the first with a thin gap between so one hard blow breaks only one.

name: Ripple Rebound
description: Let the shock ripple across the plate and fling a share of it back along the arm that struck.

name: Cleansing Veil
description: Pass a veil of clean qi over an ally and draw lingering poison or taint out of the skin and the blood.

name: Immovable Aegis
description: Hold a ward that settles so deep in the stance that no blow short of a breakthrough can shift the user.

name: Sundering Brace
description: Drive the full weight of the braced ward through the shoulder into the opponent's guard to break it open.

name: Close Mantle
description: Close a tight mantle round the user's trunk and arms at the first sign of attack.

name: Loaded Shoulder
description: Load the ward into the shoulder and drive it into the opponent's chest to shove the opponent back.

name: Still Hold
description: Go motionless behind the ward so the force of a blow finds nothing to move and dies against the stance.

name: Threat Hum
description: Feel a faint hum in the ward when an attack is gathering near it and warn the user's side.

name: Hard Return
description: Stiffen the ward and strike back at the striker's own arm with the force that struck it.

name: Pinning Ward
description: Close the ward over an opponent's weapon arm and hold it pinned against the user's guard.

name: Unmoved Barrier
description: Hold a thick barrier that does not yield an inch under a sustained press from two or more attackers.

name: Barrier Surge
description: Loose the stored pressure of the barrier outward in one pulse that throws back every attacker pressed against it.

name: Cocoon Ward
description: Round the ward into a cocoon that follows the shape of the qi field about the user.

name: Orb Rim
description: Spin the rim of the round ward so a blow that touches it is carried round the curve and away.

name: Gliding Cocoon
description: Move across open ground inside the cocoon and keep it whole as the user changes direction.

name: Sphere Reading
description: Read every touch on the surface of the round field at once and know which side the blow will fall.

name: Shared Cocoon
description: Widen the cocoon to take in an ally and feed it from the user's reserve while the ally acts.

name: Thin Orb
description: Spread the force of a hit over the whole round surface so it is a push and not a strike.

name: Layered Orb
description: Wrap three orbs one inside another so each one that breaks eases the strike for the next.

name: Orb Burst
description: Burst the outer orb outward to blow back everything pressed against it and leave the inner orb whole.

name: Cleansing Sphere
description: Fill the orb with clean qi so that poison fumes and taint in the air within it break down.

name: Orb Anchor
description: Pin the edge of the orb to the ground so an opponent cannot push it or the user aside.

name: Great Cocoon
description: Stretch the cocoon to cover a full company and hold it whole while they fight and fall back inside it.

name: Orb Collapse
description: Collapse the orb inward on an incoming force and cancel it in the crush of the folded field.

name: Reach Ward
description: Throw a ward out along the qi field to cover a target an arm's length beyond the user.

name: Outer Feel
description: Feel along the edge of the qi field for any touch on a ward set on someone beyond the user.

name: Stretch Cover
description: Stretch the ward in a long arc over an ally some paces off and hold it as the ally moves.

name: Pulled Close
description: Draw an ally in along a strand of the ward to the user's side out of the line of a blow.

name: Ward Gift
description: Send a measure of the user's ward across the field to firm an ally's guard before the blow lands.

name: Far Standing
description: Hold a ward over a distant ally steadily through an exchange without moving from the user's place.

name: Far Mending
description: Send slow mending qi along the field to an ally across the ground and close the ally's wounds.

name: Reaching Aegis
description: Raise a full ward over an ally at the far edge of the field as sturdy as one at the user's own side.

name: Turned Harm
description: Catch a blow aimed at a distant ally on the field's edge and turn it aside before it arrives.

name: Paired Plate
description: Set a plate at each shoulder and bring them together over the user's front as a matched pair.

name: Doubled Screen
description: Raise two screens at once side by side so that a blow that breaks one is caught by the other.

name: Matched Pace
description: Step in matched time with a partner so that the two wards stay edge to edge.

name: Mirrored Hold
description: Face a partner and let the shock of a blow pass through one ward and out through the other.

name: Twinned Sensing
description: Feel through the partner's ward as well as the user's own and know both fronts at once.

name: Facing Brace
description: Stand face to face with a partner and brace both wards against the press of a crowd from all sides.

name: Twin Reflect
description: Pass a blow from one ward to the other and fling it back at the attacker at an unlooked-for angle.

name: Twinned Mending
description: Heal a hurt partner by closing both wards round the wound and mending it with the pair's joint qi.

name: Mutual Seal
description: Seal an opponent's weapon between the two wards so the weapon cannot be drawn clear.

name: Aegis Joined
description: Hold the two wards as one great ward that bears a sustained press better than either could alone.

name: Twinned Verdict
description: Close both wards on the opponent's guard together and drive the pair forward in one decisive stroke.

name: Azure Plate
description: Lay a bright pale plate of qi over the body that gleams as a blow breaks across it.

name: Hawk Cover
description: Spread a wing of the ward over an ally who drops beneath the user's arm.

name: Pairing Hold
description: Hold one ward beside a partner's and share the load of a heavy hit between the two.

name: Swooping Step
description: Drop in on a fallen ally from above the field and raise the ward as the feet touch down.

name: Azure Feeling
description: Feel the whole field as a clear sky and mark any shadow of a strike that crosses it.

name: Hawk Return
description: Turn the ward on a blow and send it back along its path like a hawk turning on its prey.

name: Azure Lending
description: Lend a bright layer of the user's ward to the partner and keep it topped up through the exchange.

name: Twin Hawk Ward
description: Cast two winged wards that cross over the pair and cover each other's blind side.

name: Azure Awning
description: Spread a pale canopy over the pair like a wing and hold it against blows from above and from the sides.

name: Stooping Aegis
description: Drop with the ward held forward like a stooping hawk and slam its edge into the opponent's raised guard.

name: Flowing Ward
description: Let the ward run round the body in a smooth current that shoulders a blow aside.

name: Eddying Turn
description: Curl the ward into a small eddy that catches a thrust and spins it round the user.

name: Banked Hold
description: Bank the ward like a bank of earth against the surge of a heavy blow and let it spend itself.

name: Streamward Step
description: Flow with the press of a blow and step with it so the ward is never struck square.

name: Running Cover
description: Keep a long running ward about the user as the user advances so it moves with every stride.

name: Silt Purging
description: Wash taint and poison from an ally's body with a clear running stream of qi until the blood runs clean.

name: Flood Barrier
description: Swell the ward to a wide body of water-like qi that swallows a mass charge and spends it harmlessly.

name: Rolling Swell
description: Release the swollen ward in a rolling wave that sweeps the attackers off their feet and clears the ground.

name: Galering Ward
description: Whip a ring of wind-driven qi round the body to turn blows aside before they touch.

name: Oathbound Plate
description: Speak a short oath and set a plate of qi bound to it that holds as long as the word is kept.

name: Wind Turn
description: Whirl the ward as a gust would and fling a thrown weapon off line before it lands.

name: Squared Bearing
description: Take a bearing on the oncoming blow and meet it square so the ward swallows it.

name: Gusting Stride
description: Ride a gust of qi to the side of an ally in danger and close the ward over both.

name: Oathbound Feel
description: Feel the pull of the oath on the ward and know which sworn ally has been struck.

name: Oath Mantle
description: Cast a mantle over a sworn ally that holds firmer the longer the ally keeps the same oath.

name: Cleansing Breath
description: Drive a clean wind of qi through an ally's body to carry off poison and taint on the breath.

name: Sworn Screen
description: Raise a screen over a sworn company that grows thicker over any member that falls behind.

name: Edge Wind
description: Loose a hard gust from the rim of the ward that knocks an opponent's stance and breath out of time.

name: Unwalled Aegis
description: Hold an open ward with no fixed rim that moves with every sworn ally and covers whichever is struck.

name: Oathen Gale
description: Loose the wards of the sworn company as one great gale that drives every attacker back.

name: Vowed Bracing
description: Speak the oath aloud and brace the ward against the first blow after it.

name: Bearing Cover
description: Take a bearing on the ally to be guarded and keep the ward trained on that line.

name: Kept Bearing
description: Hold the same bearing through the whole exchange and let each blow break against the ward's set face.

name: Slant Ward
description: Set the ward at a slant to the line of attack and shed the blow along its edge.

name: Taken Oath
description: Take an oath of guard over one ally and set a ward on that ally that follows wherever the ally goes.

name: Oathbound Mend
description: Mend a sworn ally's wounds with qi that flows readily along the oath between the two.

name: Oathen Seal
description: Seal an opponent's blow against the sworn ally by binding the strike to the oath itself.

name: Oath Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that grows heavier as the oath is tested and does not fail while the oath stands.

name: Kept Word
description: Cancel an attack on the sworn ally outright by keeping the word and letting the ward drink the blow.

name: Unrimmed Ward
description: Spread a ward with no hard rim over the user and the ally nearest at hand.

name: Bearing Shell
description: Take a bearing on the strongest foe and cast a shell that faces it alone.

name: Drifting Cover
description: Let the ward drift off with a blow so the blow finds no hold and slides out to the side.

name: Wind Hold
description: Give the ward the springy weight of wind and let a heavy hit sink into it and fade.

name: Unbound Pace
description: Slip from beside one ally to beside another with the open ward following without a gap.

name: Unseen Reading
description: Feel through the open ward for the unseen weight of a hidden attacker and name its place.

name: Open Mantle
description: Spread an open mantle that settles on whichever ally in reach is most pressed.

name: Gentle Purge
description: Breathe a gentle clean wind over an ally and carry off a lingering poison on the exhale.

name: Rim Break
description: Flick the loose rim of the ward into an opponent's wrist and spoil the timing of the opponent's cut.

name: Boundless Aegis
description: Hold an aegis with no fixed rim that grows to cover as many allies as stand within the field.

name: Breath Revive
description: Seal a ward over an ally whose breath has just stopped and drive the lungs and heart to start again.
